source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Κύρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The entry is one sentence and a couplet: the venerable Kyros died peacefully. There is no century, no country, no monastery and no year, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and no hymn is printed. He is not the corpus's `cyrus-of-alexandria`, the unmercenary physician, nor `cyrus-of-constantinople`, the patriarch; both are kept on other days and both have lives. The corpus keeps nobody else of this name.
